no_lie_no_rewrite_rule: receipts that still hash; copies not all on one tunnel; verify without voice; no rewrite key; network never lies even to stay alive.

spore_rule: Last-resort failsafe after live fronts and cold-shelf mutual backup. pause / preserve / wait / physical-wipe-only. Does not replace shelves. Shelves stay intact (not failed). RE-COLD-STORE is an honest hook (no invented destinations).
